entities.summary: Chen Qiuqi (simplified Chinese: 陈秋绮; traditional Chinese: 陳秋綺; pinyin: Chén Qiūqǐ; Jyutping: Chan4 Chau1Yi2; born July 4, 1980, in Mei County (now Meixian District), Guangdong) is a female Chinese field hockey player who competed at the 2004 Summer Olympics.
